WrenchRelay LLC operates this app.

Account and maintenance information you enter in the web workspace is handled by the WrenchRelay service. Selected files are provided only through the file picker.

Speak note opens the device speech-recognition activity. Its provider may process audio under its own terms. This client receives recognized text and does not request microphone permission or capture raw microphone audio for that flow. Review text before adding it to a notes box. Typing remains available.

The app connects to wrenchrelayllc.com over HTTPS. The web service privacy policy explains service-side processing and account deletion. Deletion must be requested and processed; opening a link alone does not delete data.

AI output may be wrong. Verify the equipment, evidence, and draft before approving a maintenance record. Follow site procedures, lockout/tagout, and OEM instructions.

Contact: support@wrenchrelay.app
